item.title: azure: Announcing: Migrate Azure Container Apps logging destination from Log Analytics to Azure Monitor
item.description:
Azure Container Apps now treats Log Analytics as a legacy logging destination. Existing environments will keep working, but users are advised to plan migration to Azure Monitor logging.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [Launched] Generally Available: Azure Copilot Observability Agent supports Basic and Auxiliary table plans
item.description:
Azure Copilot Observability Agent now supports Log Analytics data stored in Basic and Auxiliary table plans for interactive analysis and deep investigations. This extends coverage to high-volume telemetry in Azure Monitor.

  • Source: Azure Updates
